Bespoke Labs

Builds realistic practice tasks for AI programs that carry out work. Its tools help teams train and test those programs.

What Bespoke Labs sells

  • RL Environments & Infrastructure: Simulates company systems using real codebases and small connected services. Provides tools to build, run and improve these environments.
  • GEPA: Uses task feedback to improve prompts and model behavior.
  • Curator: Prepares synthetic data (examples generated by software rather than collected directly) for further training and structured extraction.
  • OpenThoughts: Open research on preparing data for reasoning models.
  • Terminal-Bench: Contributes tests of agent work in command-line environments (text-based interfaces for running commands on computers).
  • Nimble: Returns probabilities for allowed answers. Nimble-v4 and Nimble-v4-max support grading and agent decisions, including routing tasks.
